usage: fleet-switchboard decisions batch [-h] --title TITLE [--row ROW]
                                         [--file FILE] [--from SENDER]

options:

  --title TITLE  One line: what the batch is about
  --row ROW      `<repo#N> | <finding> | <recommendation>`; repeat it, at most
                 40 rows
  --file FILE    Rows, one per line, from this file (`-` for stdin; with no
                 --row and no --file, piped stdin)
  --from SENDER  Lab only: the caller's fleet name
